name: meshy
description: Generate 3D models from text or images with Meshy, then texture them and download game-ready GLB, FBX, OBJ and USDZ files, using your Meshy credits.
suggestedPrompts: Turn this reference image into a textured 3D model and download it as GLB.
Generate a low-poly treasure chest for my game and export it as FBX.
Make a concept image of a sci-fi helmet, then turn it into a 3D model.
